behavior.stale_input: Dedicated discard> state retains original ownership through Enter; stale text is not echoed as fresh input. Enter acknowledges discard only, then restores the current request/message prompt. Quit/exit, EOF and cancellation remain available.
behavior.classification: One classifier distinguishes quit, discard, matching request answer and ordinary message. Rejected answers never fall back to submit; ordinary drafts survive worker completion.
behavior.drawing: Allocation-free native drawing seam returns status. Ordinary frames remain dirty and retry on the next UI event without cancelling the worker. Approval rows and refresh remain mandatory; failed rendering grants no review credit or permission. Preparation/allocation errors propagate.
behavior.preparation: Raw prose/literal and trusted rendered transcript text share bounded locale preparation; complete tokens, shared omission marker, fixed 512-byte human-rendering stack chunks, ASCII fast paths.

limits.pending_review: Complete; owned independently of ordinary transcript budgets.

behavior.backspace: One character erasure preserves previous valid/partial/malformed UTF-8 byte deletion semantics and updates cached tail once.
behavior.unchanged: Public interfaces/wrappers, strict approval policy, submitted/execution/data bytes, replay ordering, durable completion, terminal ownership, journal authority and storage formats.

discard_ui.baseline: Exit 1; both line/curses subcases fail because they show a fresh approval prompt instead of discard state. Existing stale-line guard is intentionally retained.
discard_ui.changed: Pass in full Debug/ASan and twenty focused PTY repetitions. First stale yes acknowledges discard; subsequent fresh y answers the request.

negative_controls.worker_boundary: Actual CLI helper injects clear/put/refresh failures through private callback seams. Ordinary failures preserve the active worker and partial ordinary message, later fresh display succeeds and quit returns 0. Equivalent approval failures cancel without a tool-result request. No production CLI control was added.

static_analysis.baseline_source_equivalence: Previously recorded 7f6a0bc analysis baseline has identical src/include/CMake production sources to fetched a850f04; verified with git diff.
static_analysis.interpretation: Cppcheck passes. Local Clang-Tidy has exactly five baseline source warnings plus one SDK13-incomplete platform translation unit; Clang Analyzer retains the baseline context.cpp division warning. Both return nonzero and are not claimed clean. No suppressions or checks weakened. Analyzer canaries/selftest pass.

linux_ci.coverage: Ubuntu wide-curses build, analyzer detection, all-source analysis, full CTest, pinned lint, Semgrep and Required checks.

earlier_failure_evidence.observation: Initial sanitizer full suite reported result.error=true, then aborted on missing metadata JSON indexing. No sanitizer memory-error report. Root cause unresolved; production process/spool code and this test are unchanged.
earlier_failure_evidence.final: Final complete Debug/ASan suites pass without weakening the assertion.

earlier_failure_evidence.observation: New development-time enum-size finding fixed with uint8_t; no suppression.
First baseline benchmark build rejected an unused payload overload. Replaced with template selection; no warning disabled and no extra baseline prepared-text copy.

performance.method: Identical Release compiler/settings/harnesses. One warm-up and five alternating measured runs per case/variant, repeated twice. No concurrent local tests/analyzers; no timing-based CI thresholds.
performance.first_comparison: The first correctness build reduced large-message work but showed repeatable small-message overhead. Restored ASCII fast paths, removed duplicate tokenization and used fixed stack chunks before final validation/measurements. Earlier samples are retained.

verification.emoji_deletions: 4096 cache mutations vs 16384; zero retained-tail preparation vs 24576 source bytes.

performance.large_export_repeat_interpretation: Primary sets show baseline/changed medians 327.281/490.522 ms and 337.087/382.320 ms. Two additional isolated alternating sets give 371.178/395.895 and 300.908/295.427 ms. Allocation and native-operation counts remain identical. Timing variation is unresolved; no export speedup or timing no-regression guarantee is claimed.
performance.counter_limits: C++ operator new and directly interposed native calls, not all libc/libedit activity or peak RSS. prepared_input_bytes means raw consumed source in presentation cases and rebuilt source bytes in input cases. Measurements exercise boundaries, not end-to-end keystroke latency.

compatibility_limits: Native Tiger runtime, PPC cross compiler/10.4u SDK and native Intel runtime unavailable; no passing Tiger build/runtime is claimed. Existing Tiger library configuration preserved.
Blocking-TTY cancellation and standalone/emergency best-effort delivery remain unchanged.
No guarantee of visually unique Unicode or exactly-once delivery.
